# promislow-fracton-amoeba (Full LLM Context Index)

Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648; 0_0@0thernes.art)
Version: 1.0.0 | Code License: Apache-2.0 | Prose/Paper/Data License: CC-BY-4.0

## Summary of Kernel-Checked Theorems (Lean 4.35.0, Zero Mathlib, 6 Independent Kernels)
1. T1a (`t1a_promislow_group_torsion_free`): Hantzsche--Wendt / Promislow group P satisfies exact group axioms, defining relations a^-1 b^2 a = b^-2 and b^-1 a^2 b = a^-2, non-Abelianness, and constructive torsion-freeness.
2. T1b (`t1b_faithful_four_band_bloch_homomorphism`): Faithful 4x4 twisted Bloch matrix homomorphism Psi: R[P] -> M_4(R[x^+-1, y^+-1, z^+-1]) over arbitrary commutative rings R.
3. T1c (`t1c_universal_v4_determinant_invariance`): Universal V_4-invariance of det_4(Psi(u) - E I_4) and uniqueness of the V_4-fixed origin (0,0,0), forcing constant determinant for every unit over an integral domain.
4. T1d (`t1d_eight_sign_point_factorization`): Closed-form determinant factorizations at all 8 sign points s in {+-1}^3 (4 quaternionic perfect squares + 4 abelian/sum-of-squares products).
5. T1e (`t1e_gardam_unit_mod4_and_hensel_tower`): Gardam's 21-term unit mod 2, 89-term integer determinant (const=97, aug=945, strictly V_4-invariant, det == 1 mod 4), and universal 2-adic Hensel geometric inverse tower in (Z/2^m Z)[P]^x.
6. T1f (`t1f_exhaustive_no_sign_lift_gardam_support` + `strengthened_no_sign_lift_of_gardam_support`): Exhaustive obstruction ruling out all 2^21 sign lifts on Gardam's support (and arbitrary even-sum p in Z[N]) via the quaternionic norm barrier P_1^2 - 31 not in {+1, -1}.
7. T1g (`t1g_surjunctive_reversible_linear_ca`): P-equivariance, composition law, and exact bijectivity (surjunctivity + finite-range reversibility) of Gardam's 21-neighbor linear CA on F_2^P.
8. T2a (`t2a_nonabelian_unit_twisted_css_commutation`): Unit-twisted CSS commutation over arbitrary associative involutive rings.
9. T2b (`t2b_signed_haah_64_discriminant_classification`): Exhaustive classification of all 64 signed Haah cubic codes: det(2Q) in {-12,-8,-4,+4,+8,+12} with multiplicities (12,16,4,4,16,12), smooth for all p >= 5, 24 singular F_9 splits at p = 3, universal F_4 split at p = 2.
10. T2c (`t2c_universal_all_prime_no_strings`): Universal all-prime (p >= 2 and char 0) Type-II no-strings proof for Haah CC1 via 6 pairwise Z[t] Bezout identities = 2 (plus F_4 at p = 2).
11. T2d (`t2d_odd_prime_torsion_and_p23_threshold`): (1,1,1) never a root for odd p >= 3; (-1,1,-1) roots yield k_p(L) >= 6 on all even tori; zero F_p-rational odd-order roots for odd p <= 19; first threshold at p = 23, L = 11 (k = 6) and next at p = 31, L = 15.
12. T2e (`t2e_nonabelian_hw_fracton_codes`): Gardam-twisted Haah code (weights 52+52 / 52+56; commutes strictly mod 2, 342-term even commutator defect over Z[P]) and intrinsically non-Abelian HW code commuting over all commutative rings R[P].
13. T3a (`t3a_v4_convex_ronkin_origin_minimum`): Every midpoint-convex V_4-symmetric Ronkin function R: Q^3 -> Q attains its global minimum strictly at (0,0,0), enforcing bipolar skin cancellation W_x(k_y,-k_z) = -W_x(k_y,k_z).
14. T3b (`t3b_haah_amoeba_and_ep2_jordan`): Exact quadrilateral double-amoeba characterization of A(f) cap A(g) and algebraic EP2 Jordan nilpotency (H != 0, H^2 = 0, 1D eigenspace).
15. T3c (`t3c_artin_b4_and_full_s4_monodromy`): Artin braid group B_4 relations and full 24-element S_4 monodromy closure generated by Gardam crystal loops (1 2) and (0 2 1 3).

## Explicitly Open Conjectures (NOT Claimed Solved)
- Kaplansky Unit Conjecture in characteristic 0 (Q[P] / Z[P] for general supports)
- General Gottschalk Surjunctivity Conjecture for non-sofic groups
- Asymptotic code-distance scaling of non-Abelian Hantzsche--Wendt fracton covers M_L
